It then throws java.lang.OutOfMemoryError at productCache.put (#135, #151), and the container is OOMKilled at its 2Gi limit (#136, #152). Each restart (#139, #156) re-warms the product cache, so memory climbs again and the pod dies every few minutes. The 502s at web-bff (#141, #164, #172, #198) report 'upstream search-api connection reset (no healthy upstream)' while search-api is down. They are downstream symptoms of the OOM loop, not the origin. The productCache appears unbounded: no eviction is logged and the heap does not recover after full GC. A leak introduced by release v4.15.1 would be a bad_deploy alternative, but the logs show no deploy event, so resource_exhaustion ranks higher.
